text:
alex: Morning! Radiator decided to be a heater and a sprinkler. pic: https://imgur.com/radiator-bonsai.jpg My little bonsai is steamed, power strip has a melted corner, and now my 5G hotspot keeps dropping. Anyone else had radiator + plant + wifi drama?

miriam: oh nooo 😭 post a closeup pls

alex: posted — https://imgur.com/radiator-bonsai.jpg sadly the plant is toast. wifi weirdness is the weird part, hotspot jumps from 5G->3G when it gets warm?

jules: sounds like thermal throttling on the modem. try elevating it or stick a tiny USB fan on it. been there.

sam: also fyi do NOT run extension cords under rugs. heat + cable = nope :warning:

ops-bot: Heads up: damage to home office gear caused by environmental factors (heat, water) is not covered by the central hardware replacement program. If you need a replacement, file an incident ticket here: https://redwood-internal/tickets/new

miriam: unrelated but love that LED strip under your desk — cozy vibes :heart_eyes:

leah: quick poll — visible cables or under-rug stealth? React with :thumbsup: for visible, :thumbsdown: for under-rug

alex: team visible. under-rug gave me a mini-meltdown literally.

jules: visible + clips. also, pro tip: cheap USB temp sensor saved my router once.

alex: FYI i did `sudo ifconfig wlan0 down && sudo ifconfig wlan0 up` which rebooted the hotspot temporarily, but gonna move it away from the radiator tonight.

miriam: condolences on the bonsai. also, can someone recommend a waterproof plant that survives radiators? :joy:
